thread:
anya: quick keyboard + SR pass on the Console layout after yesterday's pane split update — a few surprises :mag:
anya: 1) collapsing the left nav with the chevron doesn't move focus back to the chevron reliably; focus sometimes lands on the first focusable control in the main pane
anya: 2) when multiple toasts appear they stack visually but only the newest is announced; older toasts are aria-hidden which makes failures invisible to SR users
anya: 3) split pane resizer (the vertical drag handle) is not keyboard-accessible; no role or tabindex

theo: for the collapse we should call `trigger.focus()` on close and place a polite `aria-live` message like "Navigation collapsed". also ensure the chevron is a `<button>` not just a click-only element

riley: toasts: we use a single live region and move content in/out. propose we switch to an incremental announcer that queues short summaries and announce e.g. "Build failed: timeout" then "3 more notifications" to avoid spam. older toasts should remain visible but not aria-hidden — instead mark them as `aria-live="off"` and readable when they first appear

zoe: resizer: add `role=\"separator\" aria-orientation=\"vertical\" tabindex=0` and handle arrow keys for nudge (+ Shift for larger steps). that pattern worked in editor panes and passes screen readers

anya: also noticed focus outline in compact mode gets clipped when pane is narrow. add `outline-offset` and ensure focus ring draws above splitter

a11y-bot: scan (console-split/2026-04-12) flagged 6 issues: 2 high (resizer not keyboard accessible; collapse focus not restored), 1 medium (toasts not reliably announced). Report: https://ci.redwood/axe/scan/3899 :warning:

theo: prioritization: 1) resizer keyboard + role 2) collapse focus restore + aria-live 3) toast announcer queue 4) focus ring clipping. i'll pick up 1+4

riley: i'll implement the toast queue and add config for `announcerVerbosity` (brief | detailed | muted) stored in user prefs. plan to batch announcements and publish a small util for other teams

zoe: i'll update the resizer styles and add e2e that tabs to resizer, uses ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to nudge, and asserts SR-visible coordinate change text in a small live region

anya: creating tickets and acceptance criteria: focus returns to chevron on collapse; resizer reachable and keyboard-nudgable; toasts announce in order without hiding older items. adding links to bot scan. please post PRs as drafts and tag `@eng-accessibility` + `@design` for quick review :sparkles:

theo: will follow up with a short PR note about not relying on mouse-only handlers for these controls. thanks all — closing thread when PRs merged.
